# StoryGate

One conditional jump in a [Story](Story.md)'s script.

## Parameters

- `name`: A string. The variable the condition tests. Defaults to `""`.
- `op`: A string (see [StoryCompareOp](StoryCompareOp.md)). How the variable compares against `value`. Defaults to `"ne"`.
- `value`: An integer. The literal compared against. Defaults to `0`.
- `target`: An integer. BehaviorNode index play jumps to when the condition passes. Defaults to `0`.
